verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.107
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.107

verses.pali: 11. Valāhakavagga
verses.english: 11. Clouds

verses.pali: Mūsikasutta
verses.english: Mice

verses.pali: “Catasso imā, bhikkhave, mūsikā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these four kinds of mice.

verses.pali: Katamā catasso?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Gādhaṁ kattā no vasitā,
verses.english: One makes a hole but doesn’t live in it,

verses.pali: vasitā no gādhaṁ kattā,
verses.english: one lives in a hole but doesn’t make it,

verses.pali: neva gādhaṁ kattā no vasitā,
verses.english: one neither makes a hole nor lives in it, and

verses.pali: gādhaṁ kattā ca vasitā ca—
verses.english: one both makes a hole and lives in it.

verses.pali: imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso mūsikā.
verses.english: These are the four kinds of mice.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro mūsikūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: In the same way, these four individuals similar to mice are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Gādhaṁ kattā no vasitā,
verses.english: One makes a hole but doesn’t live in it,

verses.pali: vasitā no gādhaṁ kattā,
verses.english: one lives in a hole but doesn’t make it,

verses.pali: neva gādhaṁ kattā no vasitā,
verses.english: one neither makes a hole nor lives in it, and

verses.pali: gādhaṁ kattā ca vasitā ca.
verses.english: one both makes a hole and lives in it.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṁ kattā hoti no vasitā?
verses.english: And how does an individual make a hole but not live in it?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṁ pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual memorizes the teaching—

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
verses.english: statements, mixed prose & verse, discussions, verses, inspired exclamations, legends, stories of past lives, amazing stories, and elaborations.

verses.pali: So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: But they don’t really understand: ‘This is suffering’ … ‘This is the origin of suffering’ … ‘This is the cessation of suffering’ … ‘This is the practice that leads to the cessation of suffering’.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṁ kattā hoti, no vasitā.
verses.english: That’s how an individual makes a hole but doesn’t live in it.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā gādhaṁ kattā, no vasitā;
verses.english: That individual is like a mouse that makes a hole but doesn’t live in it, I say.

verses.pali: tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo vasitā hoti, no gādhaṁ kattā?
verses.english: And how does an individual live in a hole but not make it?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṁ na pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t memorize the teaching …

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: But they really understand: ‘This is suffering’ …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo vasitā hoti, no gādhaṁ kattā.
Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā vasitā hoti, no gādhaṁ kattā;
tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ, puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gādhaṁ kattā hoti no vasitā?
verses.english: And how does an individual neither make a hole nor live in it?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṁ na pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual doesn’t memorize the teaching …

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ nappajānāti.
verses.english: Nor do they really understand: ‘This is suffering’ …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo neva gādhaṁ kattā hoti, no vasitā.
Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā neva gādhaṁ kattā hoti, no vasitā;
tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṁ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca?
verses.english: And how does an individual both make a hole and live in it?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dhammaṁ pariyāpuṇāti—
verses.english: It’s when an individual memorizes the teaching …

verses.pali: suttaṁ, geyyaṁ, veyyākaraṇaṁ, gāthaṁ, udānaṁ, itivuttakaṁ, jātakaṁ, abbhutadhammaṁ, vedallaṁ.
So ‘idaṁ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti …pe… ‘ayaṁ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṁ pajānāti.
verses.english: And they really understand: ‘This is suffering’ …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo gādhaṁ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca.
Seyyathāpi sā, bhikkhave, mūsikā gādhaṁ kattā ca hoti vasitā ca;
tathūpamāhaṁ, bhikkhave, imaṁ puggalaṁ vadāmi.
Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro mūsikūpamā puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These four individuals similar to mice are found in the world.”

verses.pali: Sattamaṁ.
